title: Amazon Basics Cheese Grater with Handle, Stainless Steel Zester, Rectangular, Non-Slip, Multifunction Tool for Kitchen Prep, Black (Previously AmazonCommercial brand)
description:
About this item
DURABLE STAINLESS STEEL: This stainless steel cheese grater is made from 18/0 (90%) stainless steel, providing rugged strength and long-lasting reliability
ANTI-SLIP SILICONE: The handheld cheese grater features a soft black silicone handle, offering a steady grip and control while keeping it securely in place during use
MULTIPURPOSE FUNCTION: This hand cheese grater is perfect for grating cheese, vegetables, chocolate, and more, making meal preparation simple
SHARP AND EFFICIENT: Equipped with sharp stainless-steel shredding holes, our hand held cheese grater delivers efficient performance and smooth results each time
EASY CARE AND WARRANTY: This grater is dishwasher-safe for quick cleanup, and includes a 1-year limited warranty

Very sturdy and great for travel. Rubber grips are a plus.Great Grater! Stainless Steel “Commercial” Heavy Grade! Excellent quality very sharp and so much easier to use than our old flimsy rusted metal one!
Grades cheese and veggies so easily!
Well made & Very Solid !

It works.Good quality and it works great shredding zucchiniNice little basic kitchen tool. It's well made and has no slip features. It is very sharp, so take care when using and consider buying a sharp proof glove when using. Great value!So I HATE wet cheese. And my last cheese grater was a nice, middle of the line, standing cheese grater with all sorts of size options, easy to use, and easy to store. But it held water in the handle - didn't matter if I washed it by hand or in the dishwasher. And the handle couldn't be pried apart to let the water out. But it came out if you gripped it firmly. So every time I used my grater, I got wet cheese.

Introduce this beauty. Not only is it streamlined to fit in a drawer (saves under-cabinet space!), it is a breeze to clean by hand or in the dishwasher, has the same grippy bottom as my last grater, can be held a few different ways, and the best part? NO WET CHEESE.It’s great to be able to have this slim affordable cheese grater and slicer like your moms!!! I live in a small apartment and have limited drawer space. This fits right along the side on its side and my drawer fits. It’s also sharp and cleans easy just like mom had in stainless steel though!I like this little thing better than the bully box graters. It’s so much easier to whip this out for small jobs and doesn’t take up a lot of space in the dish drying rack. Glad I got it. It’s sharp and works well. I’d buy it again.

For anyone considering this product, I’d advise looking at other options that offer better usability and security.Cheap, not easy to gripDie AmazonCommercial Flache Edelstahl-Käsereibe mit rutschfestem Griff und Boden war leider kein überzeugender Artikel. Obwohl der rutschfeste Griff und Boden vielversprechend klangen, konnte die Käsereibe in der Praxis nicht überzeugen.

Zunächst einmal ist das Design enttäuschend. Die Größe und Form der Käsereibe machen es schwierig, sie bequem zu verwenden. Das Flache Design erschwert das Reiben von Käse, da es keinen ausreichenden Halt bietet. Der rutschfeste Griff allein konnte diesen Nachteil nicht ausgleichen.

Darüber hinaus erwies sich die Effektivität der Käsereibe als unzureichend. Das Edelstahlmaterial schien nicht scharf genug zu sein, um den Käse effizient zu reiben. Es erforderte viel Druck und Aufwand, um überhaupt akzeptable Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Dies führte zu Frustration und verlängerte die Zeit, die benötigt wurde, um den Käse zu reiben.

Der rutschfeste Boden erwies sich ebenfalls als enttäuschend. Anstatt Stabilität zu bieten, rutschte die Käsereibe während des Gebrauchs unerwartet hin und her, was nicht nur gefährlich sein kann, sondern auch zu ungleichmäßigen Ergebnissen führte.

Alles in allem hat die AmazonCommercial Flache Edelstahl-Käsereibe mit rutschfestem Griff und Boden meine Erwartungen nicht erfüllt. Das Design und die Effektivität lassen zu wünschen übrig, und der rutschfeste Boden bietet keine ausreichende Stabilität.
